svg.title: GainSec — printed circuit board profile
svg.desc: Top-down two-layer green printed circuit board representing the GitHub profile of GainSec (GainSec): four tones (mask over FR-4 #1a3222, mask over copper #2f451e, pad metal #b39c00, silk #e6e6e6). U1 (LQFP-100, the profile) marked GainSec REV A 1337. Zone 1 "SECURITY RESEARCH", a dashed silk courtyard of 12 TSSOP-8 chips: U4 Flock Safety [×4 2638]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Flock Safety" (anti-crime-ecosystem-research, BirdShot, Flock-Safety-Trap-Shooter-Sniffer-Alarm, flock-safety-falcon-sparrow-alpr-edl-firehose), latest push 2638; U5 Verkada [×5 2641]: 5 repositories from bullets mentioning "Verkada" (verkada-verkracked-alarm-hub-local-framework, verkada-verkracked-subghz-framework, verkada-verkracked-bullet-cam-cloud-emulator, VerkEye, verkada-verkracked-ambrella-CB62-firmwaredumper), latest push 2641; U6 Digital Ally [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Digital Ally" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U7 ThermoVu [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "ThermoVu" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U8 Uniview [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Uniview" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U9 Tridium Niagara [×1 2226]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "Tridium Niagara" (CVE-2017-16744-and-CVE-2017-16748-Tridium-Niagara), latest push 2226; U10 Kapsch TrafficCom [×1 2536]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "V2X" (Phrack-72-Raw-Output-V2X), latest push 2536; U11 MacOS [×1 2634]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "MacOS" (macos-printer-simulator-security-research), latest push 2634; U12 AutoPro [×1 2627]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "AutoPro" (3rdParty-Carplay-AndroidAuto-Dongle-Security-Research), latest push 2627; U13 Mayton [×1 2627]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "Mayton" (3rdParty-Carplay-AndroidAuto-Dongle-Security-Research), latest push 2627; U14 AOL [×1 2629]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "AOL" (AOL-Desktop-Gold-Security-Research), latest push 2629; U15 Little Tikes [×1 2525]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "Little Tikes" (Little-Tikes-DreamProjector-Reverse-Engineering), latest push 2525. Vendor board: 12 of 12 vendor chips placed in 1 zone (2 columns, row pitch 6.00 mm). Each chip stands for the repositories linked from the README bullets that mention the vendor; its laser marking is the repository count and their latest push (YYWW). 19 of the 60 repositories in the data belong to at least one vendor; the matrix, test points and totals cover those. One 0.25 mm bus from U1 runs down every column and taps pin 1 of each chip. DS2 7×12 amber LED matrix, silk PUSH/WK = repositories pushed per ISO week (repos[].pushedAt — each repository's latest push, so a repository counts at most once) for the 12 weeks 2026-08-03 to 2026-10-22; each column is one week drawn as a bar lit from the bottom, one LED per event; 8 in total, max 3 in a week. Counts: W32 1, W33 0, W34 1, W35 0, W36 0, W37 2, W38 1, W39 0, W40 0, W41 3, W42 0, W43 0. No contribution data is used. DS1 10-segment bargraph = language share by bytes: Python 9 segments (84 %), JavaScript 1 segment (13 %). Test pads TP1 GND, TP2 RX, TP3 TX (fixed labels; releases are not shown). Bench session (30 s loop, shown only in the animated file and not under reduced motion): a USB-serial adapter plugs into J3 and a debug plug seats on J1; display DS3 types the vendor under test; pulses run along the bus from U1 to that vendor's chip, a needle probe glitches its supply pin (pin 8) with a spark and a wisp of smoke, and the chip shows an open padlock. Targets in order: Flock Safety, Verkada, Kapsch TrafficCom. Static and reduced renderings show the end of the loop: every target open, the tools attached. Headers: J1 SWD 2×5 (pin 7 keyed), J3 UART 1×4 GND 3V3 TX RX. DS2 matrix and U3 driver (3731) at the right, refdes in this description only. D1 HB green heartbeat LED, D2 TX amber activity LED. The flash and its SOIC clip are not fitted on the curated board. Net list (H/V/45° routing, vias at layer changes): PWR J3–U1 0.5 mm; BUS U1–U4…U15 0.25 mm. 12 vendor chips on the board; 41 of the 60 repositories in the data match no vendor. 8 repositories pushed in the 12-week matrix window. Reduced motion: only the heartbeat LED blinks. Data captured 2026-10-22T22:21:17.411Z.
